STEP 3 - Items: Sliced strawberries (halves and quarters), no visible sauce or cream.

STEP 4 - Area: Strawberries cover nearly the whole visible interior of the bowl, about 85% of the vessel area ≈ 81 cm^2.

STEP 5 - Volume: The pile is about 2.5 cm high on average (heaped slightly above the rim in places). 81 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 200 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Cut fruit bulk density ~0.6 g/ml. 200 ml x 0.6 ≈ 120 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Fresh strawberries ≈ 32 kcal per 100 g. 120 g x 0.32 ≈ 38 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A bowl of about 120 g of sliced strawberries (roughly one cup) is plausible for this visible amount, and ~35-40 kcal is consistent with fresh strawberries.

Total: about 120 g, about 38 kcal.
